title: Sloth holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62,30 Q60,42 56,52' stroke='#e8e8a0' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='22' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#e84040'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='18' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ff8080' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M64,33 L61,35 L67,35 Z' fill='#b02020'/>
  <!-- sloth body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='66' rx='20' ry='19' fill='#9a7b5c'/>
  <!-- sloth head -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='40' r='15' fill='#b8966e'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='44' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#e8d4b0'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='40' rx='4.5' ry='5' fill='#5c4028'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='40' rx='4.5' ry='5' fill='#5c4028'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='40' r='2' fill='#2a1e14'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='40' r='2' fill='#2a1e14'/>
  <circle cx='34.7' cy='39.3' r='0.7' fill='#f0f0f0'/>
  <circle cx='46.7' cy='39.3' r='0.7' fill='#f0f0f0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='47' rx='3' ry='2.2' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M36,51 Q40,54 44,51' stroke='#5c4028' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <path d='M24,60 Q18,56 20,50' stroke='#9a7b5c' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58,58 Q64,52 62,46' stroke='#9a7b5c' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- claws -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='49' r='2' fill='#e8d4b0'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='45' r='2' fill='#e8d4b0'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='70' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#c4a585'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <path d='M32,82 Q30,86 33,86' stroke='#9a7b5c' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52,82 Q54,86 51,86' stroke='#9a7b5c' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
